title: Founder Live Runtime Execution Readiness
objective: Move approved runtime admission readiness toward governed runtime execution readiness while keeping actual execution blocked until explicitly allowed.
safetyRules: Do not enable runtime execution, execution unlock, worker/tool execution, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or provider spend in P116.1.
Do not expose DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show raw private project IDs, runtime execution record keys, raw DB table names, raw JSON, raw logs, or raw policy dumps in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions or live run buttons.
